items.event: Champions League Matchday 5: Sporting v Man Utd, Club Brugge v Liverpool, PSG v Roma, Lille v Bayern
items.line: Wednesday's main UCL slate kicks off at 05:00 JST. Man Utd are in Lisbon without the suspended Cunha and haven't won in eight away games. Liverpool are at Brugge, where both sides have 3 wins from 4. PSG host Roma, Lille host Bayern and Inter host Stuttgart.

items.event: BMW Australian PGA Championship, Round 1 (DP World Tour), The Lakes, Sydney
items.line: The DP World Tour's new season starts in Sydney with David Puig defending. Adam Scott and Min Woo Lee tee off at 04:55 JST. Cam Smith, Corey Conners and Nicolai Hojgaard go at 10:10 JST. The purse is A$2.5m, plus a PGA Championship spot.

items.event: Davis Cup Final 8 QF: Great Britain v Germany (Bologna)
items.line: Alexander Zverev leads Germany against a British team headed by Arthur Fery and Cameron Norrie. Germany lead the head-to-head 6-5. The winner plays Spain or Austria in Saturday's semi-final.

items.event: Davis Cup Final 8 QF: Spain v Austria (Bologna)
items.line: Carlos Alcaraz plays the Davis Cup for the first time since 2024, leading Spain against an Austrian team captained by Jurgen Melzer. The tie starts no earlier than 17:00 CET. Defending champions Italy are on the other side of the draw.
